hero.bio_pre: Full Stack Developer specialized in building scalable end-to-end products. Experienced in the
hero.bio_post: ecosystem, with solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure and deployment.

marcovich.description: Full platform for a premium barbershop: 5-step online booking system, client authentication, admin panel, and email + WhatsApp notifications.

codetlon.description: Institutional site for CodeTlon, an autonomous software factory. Multi-page marketing site (services, process, contact) on Next.js 14 with a Resend-powered form and GA4 analytics.

gc2.description: Public site + CMS dashboard for GC² Entrenamiento (running, duathlon and triathlon coaching). Plans, blog and contact management on Next.js 16 and Supabase, with auth and an admin panel.

chronoflow.description: DAG-based workflow engine with real async parallelism and Time-Travel Debugging: every node keeps an immutable snapshot so runs can be rewound. FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy backend on PostgreSQL, React + React Flow frontend, WebSockets for live tracking.

tutienda.description: Multi-store e-commerce SaaS in the Tienda Nube/Shopify style. No-oversell guarantee under concurrency via atomic MongoDB operations, 5 Go microservices, expiring reservations, and checkout as a saga. SvelteKit storefront with a visual editor and i18n.

inglobal.description: Institutional site for Grúas InGlobal (crane rental and industrial rigging). Rewrite of a legacy PHP site into Next.js with a CMS dashboard to edit schedule, projects, clients and content with no code changes.
